cc:Work.dc:description: Pinhole camera in XZ section, Z right and X up; virtual image plane at positive Z. Physical lengths are drawn with scale 1.0; both pixel quantities use the same scale 0.0025. f_x=600.0 px, c_x=320.0 px, x=1.8, z=4.5. The displayed triangles are exactly similar after this common pixel-to-drawing conversion, not by equating pixels with space units.
